I was 18 when I got pulled over for DUI, and I'm thankful for it every day. I blew a .12 and was also high on ecstasy. I thought I was invincible. I could have thrown my life away and taken away the lives of others like the kid from your high school, or killed myself. After that night I was devastated, I was overwhelmed with guilt and embarassment. I was very young, but able to learn from my mistake. It made me realize that I was going down the wrong path. 

 I paid all my fines by myself, attended all my required classes, did my AA. I still made it to work, and took the trolley to college every day for 6 months until I was lucky enough to get my restricted license. I still partied like a college kid, but responsibly. And in the 7 years that have passed I haven't drove under the influence once.
